releaseNotes: v5.1.4 — In-app update fixed: the updater now installs silently (/S, no wizard pages, no clicks) and the app quits fully before the installer writes, so the old version can no longer stay. After a silent install the NEW app opens by itself — Sir never has to reopen it by hand. Same Screenshot Reader fix as v5.1.3 (OCR in the main process).
